title: CMD-GEN versus PharmFlow project benchmark
status: exploratory matched sampler and common-downstream pilot complete; one of five extracted held-out cases benchmarked; not a held-out statistical benchmark
comparison_question: Does replacing CMD-GEN DiffPhar with the current PharmFlow sampler improve pharmacophore sampling or end-to-end molecule generation under matched targets and evaluation settings?

sampler_only_controls: same receptor coordinates and pocket definition
same receptor conformations (preferably fixed static structure for sampler attribution)
same consensus/GMM implementation and clustering settings
same downstream GCPG checkpoint, molecule conditions, and candidate count
same conformer generation, preparation, Vina version/settings, and random seeds
primary_comparison.end_to_end_comparison: Report separately using each method's native downstream steps, with shared receptor preparation, target set, candidate count, and scoring protocol. Do not attribute an end-to-end difference to the sampler alone.

evaluation_set.preferred: Recover the sequence-identity-controlled CrossDocked held-out split used by CMD-GEN and verify it does not overlap the PharmFlow training split.
evaluation_set.status: Official release test manifest recovered (100 names); five matching receptor-ligand examples extracted; AROE_THET8 held-out case benchmarked (10 samples per sampler, 20 molecules per arm); four remain.
evaluation_set.note: PharmFlow training-set overlap cannot be ruled out because its original split manifest is unavailable. The current performance pilot covers the three published case-study structures plus one extracted held-out case (AROE_THET8).

metrics: pharmacophore feature/type and coordinate agreement to reference
novelty against a documented common training set
MW, QED, logP, SAS, rotatable bonds
Vina score distribution and ligand efficiency
symmetry-corrected pose RMSD against crystal ligand

statistics.unit_of_analysis: target, with candidate and seed nested within target
statistics.report: paired per-target differences, aggregate mean/median, 95% confidence intervals, and target-level results
avoid: comparing local pilot scores with published scores from different targets/settings

baseline_asset.download_status: complete; testzip passed; published MD5 verified

pilot_run.shared_pocket: same ligand-centered 10 A pocket, capped at 400 heavy atoms
pilot_run.common_downstream: same local GMM, same local GCPG checkpoint/tokenizer and property conditions, same RDKit/UFF conformers, same receptor preparation, Vina v1.2.7 exhaustiveness 1 and fixed 22 A box
pilot_run.sampler_metrics: one-to-one pharmacophore-family feature precision/recall/F1 within 2 A of bound-ligand RDKit features
limitations: one random seed; three selected target case studies plus one held-out case; no confidence interval or significance test
official 100-case test manifest recovered; one of five extracted held-out cases (AROE_THET8) benchmarked and four remain; PharmFlow training overlap is unknown
common-downstream comparison uses the current project's GCPG and RDKit/UFF/Vina path, not CMD-GEN's native GCPG checkpoint and PharAlign stage
Vina is a docking score, not experimental binding affinity or efficacy
